records.name: Algeria
records.note: no prison-housing data found: after 2 search rounds + 2 fetches no Algeria-specific policy, court ruling, or documented case on where trans prisoners are housed was located. Algeria has no legal gender recognition, and the only prison-relevant datum already in the record is the US State Dept 2023 report (prison authorities separate vulnerable persons but provide no specific legal protections for LGBTQI+ persons in prison). UK CPIN DZA (26 Jul 2026, re-fetched) and Refugee Documentation Centre Ireland COI (22 Aug 2024, fetched) contain criminalisation and treatment data but no placement information; no special-custody-unit or solitary-segregation practice for trans prisoners is documented.

records.name: Ethiopia
records.note: no prison-housing data found: after 2 search rounds + 2 fetches no Ethiopia-specific policy, court ruling, or documented case on where trans prisoners are housed was located. Ethiopia has no legal gender recognition (per the record sources, trans people are legally treated as birth sex) and criminalises same-sex conduct, but no trans-specific prison-placement, special-custody-unit, or administrative-segregation practice is documented by any source found; the Federal Prison Proclamation (1174/2012, justice.gov.et, fetched) mentions vulnerability-based treatment including on account of gender but contains no trans provision; ILGA/HDT/UPR sources cover law and societal treatment only.
